description: Record a resident-paid expense as a dues credit for one apartment (קיזוז). Links the expense and a BUILDING_TAX credit in one step, applies the credit to the oldest unpaid dues and carries any surplus into the next month. No bank transaction is created and the offset is excluded from bank reconciliation. Either pass expenseId to link an existing expense, or amount and description to record a new expense.

amount.description: Credit amount. Defaults to the linked expense amount.

cashBoxAmount.description: Part of the linked expense that was paid from the building cash box.

category.description: Expense category when creating a new expense. Defaults to Other.

date.description: Date the resident paid the expense. Defaults to the linked expense date.

description.description: Expense description when creating a new expense, e.g. roof door frame.

expenseId.description: Link an existing expense instead of creating one.

name: record_offset
title: Record offset
